items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Jan Morey, down at Ridgcrest, in Rochester. So she'd have one guy to come.

ctx.x: Getting invitations to the Painters' Exposition and stuff. Bill Coleman said, "What's this? I ain't going to this." He said, "Go to that. Be sure you don't miss that." So he was getting me straight. But I got back and things was really bad then. It was the end of '54. And I'm thinking about getting a job, because are getting up in size, so I said I have to have something coming in regular. So I had nothing but this little thing where we were going to Rochester and play. So we'd do that on the weekend. That was…
there. So that wasn't nothing. You do that one week, then you had to wait another month or two before you'd go again.
